item.muzzle_guard.muzzle.desc: Wear in the face trinket slot. Blocks mouth-related animations and replaces ordinary chat with muffled syllables.
item.muzzle_guard.locked_muzzle.desc: Wear in the face trinket slot. Unlocked by default; bind and toggle it with a key.
item.muzzle_guard.collar.desc: Wear in the necklace trinket slot.
item.muzzle_guard.locked_collar.desc: Wear in the necklace trinket slot. Unlocked by default; bind and toggle it with a key.
item.muzzle_guard.key.desc: Use on yourself or another player to bind and lock the padlocked gag in the face slot. The same key toggles its lock.
item.muzzle_guard.collar_key.desc: Use on yourself or another player to bind and lock the padlocked collar in the necklace slot. The same key toggles its lock.
message.muzzle_guard.key_bound_locked: Key bound successfully; the trinket is now locked.
message.muzzle_guard.locked: The padlocked trinket is now locked.
message.muzzle_guard.unlocked: The padlocked trinket is now unlocked.
message.muzzle_guard.key_mismatch: This trinket is already bound to another key.
message.muzzle_guard.key_no_target: There is no matching padlocked trinket in the corresponding slot.
message.muzzle_guard.key_no_trinkets: Could not read the player's trinket inventory.
message.muzzle_guard.key_error: The key action failed. See the local game log at logs/latest.log.
message.muzzle_guard.master_key_unlocked: The master key removed the binding and unlocked the trinket.
item.muzzle_guard.master_key.desc: Administrator tool: removes a padlocked trinket's binding and unlocks it.
item.muzzle_guard.lockbox_photo.desc: A keepsake of a cherished bond, refusing to break the promise between you.
